# Fixture P3-FAIL-PAYOFF Storyboard

01. Rui walks home; a cracked blue cup sits on a shelf.
02. A loose window latch rattles while a friend turns on the porch light.
03. The walk continues; none of those details affects the next action.
04. At the climax, every mirror shows a flooded train station that has not appeared before.
05. A stranger in the mirror is called Rui's sister with no setup; the scene ends without a choice or cost.
